new_today_news.headline: Arkansas Grease Trap Regulations: FOG Compliance Guide
new_today_news.summary: Updated guide on Arkansas FOG compliance requirements and Fort Smith's $255 million federal consent decree addressing chronic SSOs. Details grease interceptor sizing, service intervals, and pretreatment programs under EPA oversight.
